title: Printed Books in Digital Era
description: Discussion essay about printed books
prompt:
Some people say that printed books are not necessary for the digital era. Others think printed books play an important role.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

title: Preservation of Old Buildings
description: Opinion essay about spending on old buildings vs new construction
prompt:
Many countries spend a lot of money for the preservation of old buildings. Some people think it is better to spend this money on the construction of new houses and road development.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

title: The Internet as Most Important Invention
description: Opinion essay about internet being the most important invention
prompt:
There have been many inventions in human history (for example, the wheel). Some say that the most important invention is the internet.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

title: Ambition in Modern Society
description: Two-part question about ambition
prompt:
Ambition is a positive quality for people to have in society today.

How important is it for people who want to succeed in life? Is it a positive or negative characteristic?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

title: Tourists and Environmental Responsibility
description: Discussion essay about eco-friendly tourism
prompt:
Some people believe that tourists today are more environmentally responsible and respectful of local cultures than in the past, while others argue that it is impossible for tourists to be truly eco-friendly or to protect the cultures of the countries they visit.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

title: Youth Crime
description: Causes and solutions essay about children committing crimes
prompt:
In many parts of the world, children and teenagers are committing more crimes.

Why is this happening? How should they be punished?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

title: Libraries in the Digital Age
description: Opinion essay about necessity of libraries
prompt:
Students today can easily access information online, so libraries are no longer necessary.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

title: Young People Admiring Celebrities
description: Opinion essay about media and sports stars as role models
prompt:
Nowadays, young people are admiring media and sports stars, even though they do not set a good example.

Do you think this is a positive or negative development?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

title: Food Waste Problem
description: Causes and solutions essay about food waste
prompt:
In many places large amounts of food are wasted.

What might be the reasons for this problem? What can be done to reduce food waste?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

title: Family Values vs School Education
description: Opinion essay about family values versus school knowledge
prompt:
The values we learn from our parents and family have a greater influence on our success than the knowledge and the skills we learn at school.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

title: Older People and Exercise
description: Causes and solutions essay about elderly exercise habits
prompt:
Doctors recommend that older people should get regular exercise. However, many older people do not take enough exercise.

What could be the reason for this? What can be done to encourage them to take exercise?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

title: Good News in Media

prompt:
The media should include more stories which report good news.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

title: Children Freedom

prompt:
In many parts of the world, children are given more freedom than in the past.

Is this a positive or negative development?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Is this a positive or a negative development?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

title: Robots and Human Development

prompt:
Some people think that robots are very important to humans' future development, but others think that they are dangerous and have negative effects on society.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

title: Children Concentration at School

What are the reasons? How can we solve this problem?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

title: Living Alone and Small Families

prompt:

title: Hosting Big Sporting Events
description: Discussion essay about the value of hosting major sporting events
prompt:
Some people think that it is a waste of money for countries to host big sporting events like the world cup, and that the money would be better spent on other things. However, others think that hosting large sporting events has a clear, positive impact on a country.

Discuss both these views and give your opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

title: Work vs Life Without Work
description: Opinion essay about peoples preference for work
prompt:

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

title: Success: Hard Work vs Other Factors

prompt:
Some people think that success in life comes from hard work and determination, while others think that there are more important factors such as money and appearance.

title: Language Learning Class Size

title: Air Travel and Environment
description: Opinion essay about discouraging air travel for environmental reasons
prompt:

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

title: Credit Cards: Advantages vs Disadvantages

prompt:

Write at least 250 words.

title: Young Population Trends
description: Cause and effect essay about countries with young populations
prompt:

description: Problem-solution essay about youth unhappiness despite prosperity
prompt:
In some countries young people are not only richer, but also safer and healthier than ever before. However, they are often less happy. What do you think are the reasons for this and what can be done to help?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
